summary: Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, furnishing its 2026 Annual General Meeting circular and form of proxy. The meeting is scheduled for August 25, 2026, with a record date of July 16, 2026. The circular covers routine matters: receiving audited financial statements, fixing the board at six directors, electing directors, and re-appointing De Visser Gray LLP as auditor. This is a routine management information circular for an ordinary annual meeting, containing no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, delisting, or capital return. The filing is purely procedural and administrative.
